definitions.explanation: Falling within the amount of money that has been allocated or planned for a particular purpose. Used for personal spending limits as well as business and project budgets.

examples.japanese: {予算内|よさんない}で{収|おさ}まった。
{予算内|よさんない}でいいホテルを{見|み}つけた。
examples.english: I found a good hotel within budget.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトを{予算内|よさんない}で{完了|かんりょう}させるために、{無駄|むだ}な{支出|ししゅつ}を{削|けず}った。
examples.english: To complete the project within budget, we cut unnecessary expenditures.

notes:
Combines {予算|よさん} (budget) and {内|ない} (within, inside). A practical compound used constantly in business, shopping, travel planning, and daily conversation when discussing spending.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予算内|よさんない}で{収|おさ}まる: to stay within budget
- {予算内|よさんない}で{収|おさ}める: to keep within budget
- {予算内|よさんない}で{探|さが}す: to look for something within budget
- {予算内|よさんない}で{完了|かんりょう}する: to complete within budget

CONTRASTING TERMS:
- {予算|よさん}オーバー: over budget
- {予算|よさん}{超過|ちょうか}: budget overrun (formal)
- {予算外|よさんがい}: outside the budget, unbudgeted
